title: TV streaming
description: Every phase of a tv.viktorbarzin.me stream in the order a viewer meets it: press and start, delivery through Cloudflare and the Edges, playback, and the sources. Panels marked (new) read client metrics that appear once the TV app and web player ship them.

list.name: window
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Window for rates and percentiles. Presses are sparse, so short windows leave gaps.

links.title: Viewing trends (tv admin)
links.tooltip: Per-viewing startup, stalls and bitrate from the viewing record in Postgres, which this dashboard does not read.

panels.title: Start phases, median since press (new)
panels.description: Seconds from the press to each phase: resolve, master_playlist, media_playlist, first_segment, gate_open, first_frame, moving_picture. Median over $window. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Start phases, p90 since press (new)
panels.description: As the median panel, 90th percentile over $window. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Phase ladder over the dashboard range, median (new)
panels.description: Where the time to a moving picture goes, per client, over the whole time range. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: First frame, preloaded or not (median) (new)
panels.description: Seconds from the press to the first frame, split by whether the press opened from a Server preload. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Startup segment download by cache status (new)
panels.description: Download time of the segment a start waits on, by the cf-cache-status it came back with (none = not through Cloudflare). New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Startup until playing, by preload
panels.description: tv_playback_startup_seconds, the client-reported startup wait the players already send.

panels.title: Channel resolve time
panels.description: Server side: how long a press waits for its Channel to resolve to a Feed.

panels.title: Press outcomes per hour
panels.description: Channel attempts by outcome, and presses that never drew a frame by reason.

panels.title: Segment hits, 5 min
panels.description: Cached bytes over cached plus origin-fetched bytes for media segments in the last 5-minute window Cloudflare reported. Hit, stale, updating and revalidated count as cached; miss and expired as fetched from the origin.

panels.title: Playlist hits, 5 min
panels.description: As the segment ratio, for .m3u8 playlists. Live playlists are cached for seconds, so most of them expire between viewers.

panels.title: Segment hits, range
panels.description: Byte-weighted segment hit ratio over the whole time range, one sample per 5-minute window.

targets.expr: sum_over_time(sum(max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_bytes{kind="segment", cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated"}))[$__range:5m]) / sum_over_time(sum(max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_bytes{kind="segment", cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated|miss|expired"}))[$__range:5m])

panels.title: Origin egress
panels.description: Bytes Cloudflare fetched from the origin to answer misses and expiries in the last window, as an average rate. This is the part that rides the home line.

panels.title: CF window age
panels.description: Age of the newest window. Windows are read 3 minutes after they close, every 5 minutes, so 3 to 8 minutes is normal. The Edge stops exporting a window 20 minutes after it closed, so this panel goes empty rather than past that.

panels.title: CF query ok
panels.description: 1 when the last analytics query succeeded. Empty means no Edge has a token or the job has not run yet.

panels.title: Cloudflare hit ratio by kind
panels.description: By bytes, per 5-minute window.

panels.title: Cloudflare hit ratio by kind, by requests
panels.description: The same ratio counted in requests rather than bytes. For playlists this is the share of playlist reloads the origin did not have to answer.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_requests{cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated"})) / sum by (kind) (max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_requests{cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated|miss|expired"}))

panels.title: Segment bytes by cache status
panels.description: What Cloudflare sent viewers for media segments, as an average rate over each window.

panels.title: Requests by kind and cache status
panels.description: Requests per 5-minute window (Cloudflare's sample-adjusted estimate).

targets.expr: sum by (kind, cache) (max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_requests))

panels.title: Bytes by colo
panels.description: Which Cloudflare data centres serve the households. The top 8 by bytes are named, the rest are 'other'.

panels.title: Segment hit ratio by colo
panels.description: Each colo keeps its own cache, so a second household in a new colo starts cold.

targets.expr: sum by (colo) (max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_bytes{kind="segment", cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated"})) / sum by (colo) (max by (kind, cache, colo) (tv_cf_bytes{kind="segment", cache=~"hit|stale|updating|revalidated|miss|expired"}))

panels.title: Cloudflare sampling and rows
panels.description: Sample interval 1 means every request was counted. Rows at 10000 means the window had more distinct paths than one free-plan query returns.

panels.title: Edge upstream copy
panels.description: Bytes the Edges hold in the upstream copy (ADR-0045), by kind.

panels.title: Upstream copy reads
panels.description: Reads of the upstream copy per minute, by outcome.

panels.title: Server preload
panels.description: What the Edge holding the lease reads ahead for likely presses, against its budget.

panels.title: Stalls per hour
panels.description: Stalls clients reported, per hour of wall-clock time.

panels.title: Stalled seconds per hour
panels.description: Seconds clients spent stalled, per hour of wall-clock time.

panels.title: Stalled share of watching (approximate)
panels.description: Stalled seconds over watched seconds. Watched seconds are estimated as viewing beats written times 20 s, the heartbeat interval of both the web player and the TV app.

panels.title: Segment loads by cache status (new)
panels.description: Segment loads per minute during playback, by the cf-cache-status they came back with. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Segment loads served from Cloudflare cache (new)
panels.description: The players' view of the hit ratio: share of their segment loads answered from cache. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Steady segment load time (new)
panels.description: Download time of each segment after the start, by cache status. New client metric: shows data once the TV app and web player ship the client phase metrics (tv_start_phase_seconds, tv_start_segment_seconds, tv_segment_loads_total, tv_segment_load_seconds).

panels.title: Fatal errors and downshifts per hour
Upstream segment fetch time, p90
panels.description: How long the Edges take to fetch a segment from the source sites, by host.

panels.title: Relay time per segment
panels.description: Average seconds /relay spent fetching each segment, by site.

panels.title: Watcher download
panels.description: What the Watcher reads to keep its measurements, against its budget.
